name: IFC schema is IFC4
check_logic: Read the IFC header. The schema must be IFC4.

name: COBie file opens
check_logic: The COBie file opens as an .xlsx workbook.
message: COBie file could not be opened

name: Required COBie sheets present
check_logic: The workbook has these sheets: Contact, Facility, Floor, Space, Type, Component, System, Job, Document, Attribute.

name: Required fields filled
check_logic: Every field marked required = Y in the data dictionary has a value. Blank or a placeholder from code_lists:placeholder counts as empty.

name: Conditional fields filled
check_logic: Every field marked required = C has a value when its condition is true (e.g. Job rows for emergency light fittings only).

name: Data types valid
check_logic: Dates are ISO 8601. Decimals and integers are numbers with no unit text. Booleans are Y or N. Emails and GUIDs match their pattern.

name: Values match pattern
check_logic: Every value with a pattern in the data dictionary matches it (asset, type and space names; classification format; GUIDs).
message: {field} on {object} does not match the required format: {value}

name: Values in allowed list
check_logic: Every value with an allowed list in the data dictionary is one of those values (e.g. FireRating, CallType, TMVApproval, SetTemperature).

name: Numbers above minimum
check_logic: Every number with a min_value of >0 is greater than zero.

name: Container name fields valid
check_logic: Split each container name on hyphens. There must be 7 fields, and each field must be in its code_lists list (project, originator, volume, level, doc_type, role; number is 6 digits). Report which field is wrong.

name: Container name used for one deliverable
check_logic: A container name is not used for two different titles in the register.
message: {container} is used for more than one title

name: Asset names unique
check_logic: No two assets share a name in the IFC, and none in the COBie Component sheet.

name: Space names unique
check_logic: No two spaces share a name.

name: Name prefix matches asset type
check_logic: The code at the start of each asset name (e.g. TMV) matches the asset type found from its Pr classification in asset_types.
message: {object} is named as {prefix} but classified as {asset_type}

name: Pr code allowed for asset type
check_logic: Each type's Pr code is one listed for that asset code in asset_types.

name: No withdrawn Uniclass codes
check_logic: No Pr, SL or Ss code appears in code_lists:withdrawn_uniclass.

name: SL code matches space schedule
check_logic: Each space's SL code equals the space_schedule value for that space name.

name: Room name matches space schedule
check_logic: Each space's room name equals the space_schedule value (ignoring case and extra spaces).

name: Patient area flag matches schedule
check_logic: Each space's PatientArea equals the space_schedule value.

name: Floor name valid
check_logic: Each floor name is in code_lists:floor.
message: Floor {value} is not a project floor

name: Emergency flag matches Pr code
check_logic: EmergencyLighting is Y for Pr_70_70_48_77 and N for Pr_70_70_48_70 (asset_types.emergency).
message: {object} EmergencyLighting is {value} but its Pr code means {expected}

name: Maintenance interval within maximum
check_logic: Convert Job.Frequency to months with code_lists:frequency_unit. It must be no more than asset_types.max_interval_months for that type.
message: {object} is maintained every {value} months; maximum is {expected}

name: Installation date not in the future
check_logic: InstallationDate is on or before the submission date.
message: {object} installation date {value} is after the submission date

name: Status valid and not S0
check_logic: Each register entry has a status in code_lists:status other than S0.

name: Revision type matches status
check_logic: S1-S4 need a P revision. A0-A7 and CR need a C revision.

name: Planned container delivered
check_logic: Each MIDP container appears in the register by its due date. Only checked once the check date has passed the due date.
message: {container} ({exchange}) was due {due_date} and is not in the register

name: Right status by due date
check_logic: Take the latest register entry with status_date on or before the due date. Its status rank (code_lists:status value) must be at least the MIDP required status. Only checked once the check date has passed the due date.

name: Early warning before due date
check_logic: If a due date is within 10 working days of the check date and the container is below the required status, warn.

name: Revisions move forward
check_logic: Per container, sorted by status_date, revisions only go up (P01 < P02 < ... < C01 < C02) and no revision appears twice.

name: Container not in MIDP
check_logic: Each register container is in the MIDP.

name: IFC asset missing from COBie
check_logic: Every IFC element of an entity listed in asset_types has a COBie Component with the same name.
message: {object} is in the IFC but not in COBie

name: COBie asset missing from IFC
check_logic: Every COBie Component has an IFC element with the same name.
message: {object} is in COBie but not in the IFC

name: GUIDs match
check_logic: For each asset found in both files, Component.ExtIdentifier equals the IFC GlobalId.
message: {object}: COBie GUID {value} does not match IFC GlobalId {expected}

name: Asset in exactly one space
check_logic: In IFC each asset is contained in or referenced by exactly one IfcSpace. Component.Space names a space in the Space sheet. Both files name the same space.
message: {object} is in {count} spaces / space {value} not found / IFC says {expected}

name: Spaces match schedule
check_logic: Every space_schedule space exists in IFC and COBie, and neither file has extra spaces.

name: Space on a floor
check_logic: In IFC each IfcSpace is aggregated to an IfcBuildingStorey. In COBie Space.FloorName exists in the Floor sheet.
message: Space {object} has no floor / floor {value} not found

name: Asset linked to a type
check_logic: In IFC each asset has a type object. In COBie Component.TypeName exists in the Type sheet.
message: {object} has no type / type {value} not found

name: Manufacturer in Contact sheet
check_logic: Type.Manufacturer exists as an Email in the Contact sheet.

name: IFC manufacturer matches Contact company
check_logic: The IFC Manufacturer name equals Contact.Company for the email held in COBie.
message: {object}: IFC says {value}, COBie contact company is {expected}

name: IFC and COBie values agree
check_logic: For every data dictionary field held in both files, the IFC value equals the COBie value. Dates compare on the date part; classification compares the code part. Skips GUID (L3-03), space (L3-04) and manufacturer (L3-09), which have their own rules.

name: Warranty starts on or after installation
check_logic: WarrantyStartDate is on or after InstallationDate.

name: Assets in the right system
check_logic: Each asset whose type has an Ss code in asset_types is listed in exactly one COBie System (and IfcDistributionSystem) with that Ss code.

name: Patient basins protected by a TMV
check_logic: Every WHB in a space with PatientArea = Y is named in ServesComponent by exactly one TMV in the same space. Every TMV serves a WHB in its own space.
message: {object} in {space} has no TMV / is served by {count} TMVs / TMV serves a basin in another space

name: Call points where required
check_logic: Each treatment room, the paediatric clinic room and the nurse room has at least one NCU. Each accessible WC has at least one EAC.

name: Emergency lighting where required
check_logic: The corridor and the plant room each have at least one LF with EmergencyLighting = Y.

name: PPM job for each type
check_logic: Each Type in scope has at least one Job with Category = PPM (LF only where EmergencyLighting = Y).

name: Asset count as expected
check_logic: The number of assets per asset type and variant equals asset_types.expected_qty.

name: IFC entity matches asset type
check_logic: Each asset uses the IFC entity, predefined type and object type given in asset_types for its Pr code.

name: Task description is specific
check_logic: Flag job descriptions that only say something generic (e.g. 'service as per manufacturer') and do not name actual tasks.
message: Review: {object} task description may be too generic

name: TMV tasks complete
check_logic: Flag TMV job descriptions that do not appear to include both an outlet temperature check and a fail-safe (cold supply isolation) test.

name: Fire damper tasks complete
check_logic: Flag fire damper job descriptions that do not appear to include a drop test and reset.

name: Unreadable submission
check_logic: Any fail on L1-01 to L1-03 rejects the whole submission.

name: IFC and COBie don't match
check_logic: Any fail on L3-01 to L3-03 rejects the whole submission.
message: Submission rejected: IFC and COBie do not match

name: Safety-critical fail
check_logic: Any fail on an asset where asset_types.safety_critical = Y, or on L1-19, L3-13, L3-14 or L3-15, rejects the whole submission.

name: Container fail
check_logic: Any fail on L1-10, L1-11, L1-24, L1-25 or a layer 2 rule rejects that container only.

name: Non-critical fail rate
check_logic: For assets that are not safety-critical, fails divided by attribute checks run. Over 5% rejects the submission; 5% or less accepts it with a correction list.

name: Warnings and flags
check_logic: Warnings go on a response list for the lead appointed party. Flags go to a named reviewer in the estates team. Neither changes the outcome.
message: {count} warnings to answer, {count2} flags to review
